summary: Implemented every stub in babel/util.py, babel/localtime/_unix.py, babel/localtime/_fallback.py, babel/messages/pofile.py and babel/messages/frontend.py, restoring the helpers the skeleton had dropped (_cmp, FixedOffsetTimezone tz methods, the PO parser state machine, CommandMixin.ensure_finalized, and the four command classes' initialize/finalize/run methods); babel/__init__.py had no stubs. Last full-suite run I saw: 4752 passed, 1952 failed; the failures I traced are in other builders' files (catalog, dates, numbers, localedata, extract, jslexer) or environmental (no distutils entry points, no tzdata), and none point at my files.
